Divide each sheet dimension by the part dimension, round each answer down, then multiply. E.g. 1220 ÷ 200 = 6 and 610 ÷ 150 = 4, so 24 parts.

front: Why round down when calculating parts?
back: You cannot use part of a part — an incomplete piece is waste.
